stock.description: Rainmed Medical Limited is a medical technology firm specializing in the creation, development, and market launch of advanced systems that utilize coronary angiography to assess fractional flow reserve (FFR) and the index of microvascular resistance (IMR). Its offerings include the FlashAngio caFFR System, which accurately determines FFR values by reconstructing a three-dimensional model of the coronary arterial system from two angiographic images. Additionally, the company provides the FlashAngio caIMR System, an innovative non-invasive solution for the diagnosis and treatment of microcirculatory lesions. Rainmed Medical is also engaged in pioneering intelligent angiographic injection technologies, robotic navigation systems for vascular interventions, and flash renal denervation solutions. Established in 2014, the company is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
